title: Gate every CUJ-state record with explicit proof coverage
createdBy: codex after chairman requested a system for testing every CUJ state

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: operator asked how to make sure every CUJ state is tested.
historicalContent.description: Create an enforceable CUJ-state coverage gate. Each required CUJ-state id must have a proof entry, missing and unknown state ids must fail, release evidence must carry the coverage manifest, and release doctor must block a release spine that lacks complete CUJ-state proof coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: VaporizeTestSupport can build a CUJ-state coverage manifest from a CUJ-state document and proof entries.
The manifest records required, covered, uncovered, unknown, and duplicate proof state ids.
The focused CUJ-21 tests prove passing coverage, missing-state failure, and unknown-state failure.
Release doctor requires the CUJ-state coverage artifact, validates JSON, and blocks uncovered, unknown, or duplicate proof ids.
Release PRD, CUJ map, gates, launch-review packet, engineering docs, and feature catalog all name the CUJ-state coverage gate.
The gate remains scoped to CUJ-state coverage and does not claim Kura, Turso, libSQL, sync, migration, or public release readiness.
